Subject: Need help with a land dispute case

Hello, my name is Simran Srivastava. I am a 62-year-old journalist living in Kolhapur. I have a land dispute with Kavya Pawar over land worth ₹85,20,000, and relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 66564 25751 or email simran.srivastava@example.com.
